tests: [evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should work from-inside an exposed function
reason: Exposes a function the page calls back into Node with `page.exposeFunction`, which Strider doesn't have; the test calls `page.evaluate` from inside it. The matrix row is `missing`, and Strider's evaluation arguments can't carry a callback

tests: [evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should accept a string
[evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should accept a string with semi colons
[evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should accept a string with comments
decision: Evaluation takes a function, never a string of source
reason: Passes a string expression to `page.evaluate`, which Puppeteer runs as source and Strider's `evaluate` doesn't accept: it takes a function. The matrix row says `has` for the function form, and no row covers a string expression

tests: [evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should throw if elementHandles are from other frames
reason: Takes a handle to a frame's `body` with `frame.$`, which Strider's frame locator doesn't give: it has no evaluation-handle operation, so the handle the test passes into the page's evaluation can't be made. The matrix row is `missing`

tests: [evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should accept element handle as an argument
[evaluation.test] Evaluation specs Page.evaluate should throw if underlying element was disposed
reason: Creates a handle with `page.evaluateHandle`, and passes it back into `page.evaluate`, which runs in the isolated world. Stock WebKit has no isolated worlds (`isolatedWorlds` is unsupported), so it fails `Unsupported` there
